name: T_box per stage (stall time box)
how_measured: The intervals between progress events (drops in V, or new source ids on uncovered questions) in the pilot's transcripts and files; set T_box to twice the 95th percentile (D3-06)
value_until_measured: The owner sets one box per stage before the pilot; no measured value exists

name: Watcher tick Δ and coalescing delay δ
how_measured: The distribution of poll gaps (sets the pause slack); coordinator wakes per task and events per wake; keep the extra delay below T_box/10 (D3-07)

name: T_watch (the watcher's own deadline)
how_measured: The longest quiet stretch in the pilot when no event was due; the wake cost of the coordinator's window at each forced wake
value_until_measured: Equal to the shortest T_box (a guess)

name: Loop length k
how_measured: False loop flags against true loops in the pilot transcripts
value_until_measured: 3 identical tool-call signatures in a row (D3-06)

name: Peak spend rate and wake latency
how_measured: Tokens per minute per session from the transcripts; the time from a watcher exit to the coordinator's first script call. Together they set the hard limit e − (Δ + latency) × rate (D3-05)
value_until_measured: The hard limit is 0.9 of the escrow until measured (a guess); the soft limit is 0.8 (D3-05)

name: Peak memory per session and the reserve
how_measured: A free-memory trace and per-process memory (tasklist) during the pilot, helper bursts included (D3-03)
value_until_measured: The reserve is the owner's figure; at most 2 children until the peak is measured (amendment 3, row 8)

name: Tokens per percent of the weekly meter
how_measured: Transcript token totals against the meter readings taken by the coordinator at each wake (D1-08)
value_until_measured: Unknown; admission uses the owner's pilot allowance A_pilot in tokens

name: Cost per question ĉ and margin m
how_measured: The pilot's transcript tokens per approved question; m = the largest overrun seen, floored at the owner's margin (D3-04, D1-08); the estimate itself comes from the Shape layer

name: W_cc (common-cause window)
how_measured: The times of failures and pauses in the pilot and wave 1; the share of failures that were common cause (D1-09)

name: H_max (hand-overs per task) and Z (zombie tokens before escalation)
how_measured: Hand-overs per task and the reload overhead (D3, thrashing); tokens spent after a fence by sessions whose stop did not take effect
value_until_measured: H_max = 2 and Z = 10 % of the task's escrow (both guesses)

name: Whether pause detection works and whether a background script keeps the PC awake
how_measured: Induce one sleep in the pilot (D4-06); check the logged gap, that nobody was suspected, and whether the PC slept while only the watcher ran

name: Stop effectiveness and orphan helpers
how_measured: Transcripts of a stopped session and of its helpers that still grow after the stop; processes left behind

name: Helper-transcript linkage and turn-end visibility
how_measured: Whether spend.mjs can tie each helper transcript to its parent session, and whether a turn end is visible in the transcript
value_until_measured: Not established; until it is, spend is marked partial

name: Helper results lost per crash
how_measured: Helper results in a dead attempt's transcript minus the cards journaled by put.mjs (decides whether salvage.mjs is built, D1-03)

name: Snapshot coverage: share of cards with a stored snapshot; share whose quote is found; share needing PDF extraction
how_measured: snap.mjs and witness.jsonl counts over the pilot field

name: Drift rate between read time and check time
how_measured: Refetch a random sample at check time; count source_changed
value_until_measured: Unknown; every refetch difference logged, never treated as mismatch

name: p (per-card drop rate and correction rate), c (checker tokens per card), R (tokens to repair a citing sentence), N_p/N_c
how_measured: status lines and transcripts of the pilot; feeds the strict-or-optimistic check order of D2-10
value_until_measured: Optimistic order (check cited cards after the review) with the stale cascade in place

name: Blast radius per retracted card

name: Fact sentences failing the scope CHECK; dropped conditions; numbers in prose matching no cited card
